name: isoscope
description: Schematic observability: your system as an inspectable isometric city, driven by one JSON spec or a SQLite graph store.

scripts.build:self: bun cli.ts import examples/isoscope.spec.json /tmp/isoscope-self.db && bun cli.ts build /tmp/isoscope-self.db out/isoscope.html
scripts.proof:contrast: bun cli.ts import examples/isoscope.spec.json /tmp/isoscope-self.db && bun cli.ts build /tmp/isoscope-self.db /tmp/isoscope-self.html && bun scripts/contrast-proof.ts /tmp/isoscope-self.html
